title: Study on underwater navigation of crawler type mining robot
authors: Tae-Kyeong Yeu; Suk-Min Yoon; Seung-Jea Park; S. Hong; H. -W. Kim; Chang-Ho Lee; J. -S. Choi; Ki-Young Sung
